title: Juniper and the Promise
author: Juniper Ashgrove
blurb: Astrid Hartwell, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the festival ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
